title: Offer AI Agent Swarms Under Your Brand | AIify Partner Program
description: Offer your clients done-for-them AI agent swarms under your brand. You keep the client and set the price. We co-manage the work behind you for a fixed fee.

hero.heading: Give your clients a premium AI offer under your brand.
hero.body: Offer your clients a premium offer they really want: done-for-them AI agent swarms, co-managed by our expert AI management team. You keep your clients, and we serve them with you.

intro.label: Why now
intro.heading: Now you have the AI advantage.
intro.lead: Your clients now expect an active AI advantage from you. If you don't bring one, they'll start going elsewhere for it.
intro.question: But how do you do that when all your effort already goes into delivering your current service, AI is changing like crazy, and you still have to stay on top of your own industry?

hard.label: The hard way
items: Pay for an in-house AI team
Hire a manager to run them
Keep up with AI as it changes
Do all of it while running your company and expanding in your industry

ours.label: Our way
ours.sub: Let us do it with you.
items: We build and run the AI with your clients, under your brand.
You keep the client and the profit.

intro.closing: Partner with us and we do all of that with you, under your brand. You keep your customer.

model.heading: What your clients get
model.body: Many companies buy AI software and nobody uses it. Your clients get people, not just software. We set the swarm up for them, build it with them every week, and check on it every day. That's why it gets used, and why your clients stay happy with you.
model.label: How it works

steps.title: You keep the client.
steps.body: You make the offer under your brand. The client stays yours.

steps.title: We set it up for them.
steps.body: We set up the AI agent swarm around how their business already runs.

steps.title: We build with them every week.
steps.body: At the start, each user gets a weekly build session with us of about 30 minutes. We check in every day to keep it working.

steps.title: We aim the agents at their goals.
steps.body: Each quarter, we set their goals in the system so the agents stay focused on what matters.

steps.title: The credit goes to your brand.
steps.body: Their team builds it with us and gets better at it. Your client sees the results under your brand.

model.platform: We currently co-manage in Grok Bot, and our approach doesn't depend on any one platform.

evidence.heading: What it looks like when it works
evidence.body: This is a recent engagement we ran directly. It's one engagement, not a guarantee. It shows what your clients could get.
facts: One account: an executive and their chief of staff.
We connected to their systems, including one with no API. For that one, we sign in and pull the numbers several times during the workday.
We built live dashboards their team uses to run the business.
Within two weeks, the savings covered more than a year of the cost.
evidence.closing: That's the result you want under your brand.

economics.label: Partner economics
economics.heading: One simple price per company account.
economics.body: We deliver for $4,000 per month per company account. Each account covers an executive and their chief of staff or assistant. Need more people? Add another account.

points.title: You sell it at a premium.
points.body: We recommend selling it for $10,000 a month and keeping the difference.

points.title: You keep all the client data.
points.body: The data stays with you and your client.

points.title: You pay us monthly.
points.body: Your bill is based on the number of accounts.

points.title: It scales with your clients.
points.body: Need more people? Add another account. Each new account is an additional $4,000 a month for us to fulfill. There's no limit to how far it scales.

ownership.label: What you keep
ownership.heading: Your client. Your work. Your long-term position.

points.title: You keep the client.
points.body: Your client buys from you and works with you. We serve them with you, behind your brand.

points.title: You own the client work.
points.body: What we build for each client is yours: their instructions, playbooks, and agent setups. AIify keeps its methods.

points.title: You keep a long-term offer.
points.body: This is a long-term engagement. Building it in-house later is rarely cheaper. You can offer your clients an arrangement that keeps working.

questions.q: Will my clients know AIify is involved?
questions.a: You are the face of the offer and you own the relationship. We are your backend.

questions.q: Shouldn't we just build this team ourselves?
questions.a: It's rarely cheaper. You'd have to hire, train, and manage the team yourself. With us, you get the offer without the headcount.
No. Software is a small part of it. Your clients get setup, weekly build sessions, daily check-ins, and quarterly goals.

quote.heading: Let's talk about a partnership.
quote.body: Tell us a little about your business and your clients. We'll get back to you personally.
